definitions.explanation: Used or discarded paper that is no longer needed.

examples.japanese: {紙屑|かみくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ゴミ{箱|ばこ}→ゴミ箱：06994_gomibako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{捨|す}てた→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: I threw the wastepaper in the trash can.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{紙屑|かみくず}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{散|ち}らばっている→散らばる：12713_chirabaru⟧。
examples.english: Scrap paper is scattered on the desk.

examples.japanese: {紙屑|かみくず}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。

notes:
{紙屑|かみくず} means wastepaper or scrap paper that is discarded.

FORMS:
⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ (paper) + {屑|くず} (scraps, waste)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {紙屑|かみくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away wastepaper
- {紙屑|かみくず}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to gather up scrap paper
- {紙屑|かみくず}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to reduce to waste (figurative: to make worthless)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{屑籠|くずかご}→屑籠：noentry⟧/⟦{紙屑入|かみくずい}れ→紙屑入れ：noentry⟧: wastepaper basket
- ⟦ゴミ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧: garbage, trash
- ⟦{古紙|こし}→古紙：21849_koshi⟧: used paper (for recycling)
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧ゴミ: paper waste
